name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She stands with the staff planted and her free arm raised high, palm open to the sky, her hair and fringe lifted by a rising spirit-wind, chin lifted, a fierce, proud gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Glowing spirits of beasts rise from the standing stones and circle her, the ancestral fires leap high, {{MAGIC}} motes and leaf litter spiral upward and the totem poles glow along their carved faces.

notes: HOLO edition 'Spirit Mother': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
